name: acc7-schema-extraction-analysis
description: Skills + MCP client for auditing an Adobe Campaign Classic v7 instance ahead of a v8 migration: extract structure/config via a read-only ACCv7 MCP server, then produce a testing-team verification deliverable.

acc_base_url.title: ACC base URL
acc_base_url.description: Base URL of the ACCv7 instance, e.g. https://your-instance.adobesandbox.com

acc_login.title: ACC login
acc_login.description: Native operator login (an Adobe ID cannot use the ACC SOAP API)

acc_password.title: ACC password
acc_password.description: Password for the native operator login above

acc_mcp_url.title: ACC MCP server URL (http transport)
acc_mcp_url.description: Only used by the acc7-http server entry. Leave default if running the server locally.

acc_mcp_server_bin.title: ACC MCP server binary (stdio transport)
acc_mcp_server_bin.description: Only used by the acc7-stdio server entry. Path to, or name on PATH of, the acc-mcp-server binary from https://github.com/Bounteous-Inc/acc7-mcp-server.
